stack: static HTML, no build step, no server, no database
what: Administrator documentation site for forqsite (self-hosted multi-tenant website builder), plus a dev-to-prod gap analysis doc
why: forqsite.com is dogfooded as a tenant on a forqsite install; this docs site deliberately is NOT, so docs stay available when a forqsite instance is down
build_command: none — static HTML, open file:// or serve with any static file server
test_command: none — static HTML, open file:// or serve with any static file server
